archetype: LUXURY & PERFORMANCE PRO (Glacier Icy Dark Theme)
target_audience: Residential homes, corporate offices, event managers, and commercial spaces across Greater Toronto Area (GTA), Canada

typography.mono_accent: JetBrains Mono, monospace (For labels, coordinates, batch IDs, postal tags)

scale.h1_hero: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-extrabold tracking-tight leading-none
scale.caption: text-xs uppercase tracking-[0.2em] font-mono text-cyan-400

layout_and_bento.spacing_philosophy: Generous spacing system using p-6 to p-24. Containers with borders MUST have p-6 or p-8 internal padding.

header.style: Sticky crystal glass (backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#091322]/80 border-b border-cyan-500/20 z-50)
elements: Navigation links (Home, Water We Deliver, Delivery Areas, Events & Bulk, Gallery, About, Contact)

hero_section.style: Large kinetic hero with masked line-by-line reveal, icy dark atmosphere, parallax image overlay

postal_checker.description: Interactive Delivery Area Checker supporting GTA postal codes (M1-M9, L1-L7, etc.) and cities (Toronto, Mississauga, Brampton, Vaughan, Markham, Richmond Hill, Oakville, Burlington, Pickering, Ajax, Whitby, Oshawa)
postal_checker.verdict_ui: Instant green/cyan status indicator with estimated delivery timeframe (Within 24 Hours) and immediate order CTAs

catalog: Eska Natural Spring Water (35-Pack Cases Only)
products_section.pricing: Quote-based pricing (customized based on quantity and location)

manifesto_section.format: Numbered manifesto chapters (01 Pure Springs, 02 Cold Supply Chain, 03 Doorstep Dolly Delivery, 04 GTA Express)
manifesto_section.style: Asymmetric editorial cards with glowing borders

quote_modal_and_forms.action: Submits form to backend FastAPI email service + offers seamless 'Continue on WhatsApp' trigger pre-populated with quote details

floating_whatsapp.visible: Always visible bottom-right widget with notification ping effect for high-conversion engagement

instructions_to_main_agent: Load Google Fonts ('Outfit', 'Plus Jakarta Sans', 'JetBrains Mono') in public/index.html or top of index.css
Use Lenis smooth scrolling or Framer Motion page scroll transitions
Strictly use real asset URLs provided in 'design_assets'
Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes (e.g. data-testid='postal-code-input', data-testid='whatsapp-hero-cta')
Build backend integration with FastAPI server in /backend/server.py for sending quotes via email
Include all 8 mandatory pages/sections: Home, Water We Deliver, Delivery Areas, Events & Bulk Orders, Gallery, About, Contact, Privacy/Terms/Delivery Policies
Follow dark cold icy aesthetic with high APCA visual contrast and responsive mobile drawer navigation
